fieldAssessments.assessment: Small experiment is relevant, but unstable scheduling is invented; no concrete experiment is selected.
Desire to return is given; inspiration as a supportive frame fits Star upright. Mild interpretation rather than serious biographical overreach, though inspiration is not explicit.
Two of Pentacles reversed supports checking capacity, not asserting the user already has a busy schedule; if-clause does not neutralize that presupposition.
Exploration fits Page of Wands upright. Easier maintenance is plausible advisory language, not a guarantee, though it should be offered as a possibility rather than universal effect.

cardSpecificityNotes: Themes and orientations align broadly. Reversed Two of Pentacles has been turned into factual schedule knowledge; no literal card/orientation error.
